name: Lokalise -> Figma Screenshot Sync
description: On a new Lokalise key (webhook), fetch the key, match it to a Figma screen via namespace rules + text index, then attach that screen's screenshot to the key and tag the key with the screen name. Unmatched keys are left untouched.

const kn = root.key_name;
const keyName = (typeof kn === 'string') ? kn : (kn && (kn.web || kn.other || Object.values(kn)[0])) || '';
const dk = keyName.replace(/::/g, '.');

  { prefix: 'contest', screen: 'D - Home page', shot: 6906682 }
];
let m = RULES.find(r => keyName.indexOf(r.prefix) === 0);
const last = dk.split('.').pop() || '';
const BTN = ['cta','submit','button','btn','action'];
let etype = BTN.some(w => last === w || last.indexOf(w) !== -1) ? 'Button' : '';
let ctxParts = dk.split('.'); if (ctxParts[0] === 'pages' || ctxParts[0] === 'components') ctxParts = ctxParts.slice(1);
const ctx = ctxParts.join(' > ').replace(/_/g, ' ');
const screen = m ? m.screen : '';
const desc = (etype ? '[' + etype + '] ' : '') + screen.replace('D - ', '') + ' · ' + ctx;
const tags = []; if (screen) tags.push(screen); if (etype) tags.push(etype);
return { keyId: root.key_id, keyName: keyName, matched: !!m, screen: screen, tags: tags, etype: etype, description: desc.slice(0,250), reason: m ? 'namespace' : 'unmatched' };

parameters.content:
## Setup
Register this webhook URL in Lokalise (project -> Apps/Webhooks) for the "New key added" (project.key.added) event.

## Hybrid matching
Namespace rules + text-index seeded with 3 screens (Login, Contact, Pricing). Add a rule + screenshot id per screen as the full screenshot pass runs. Keys that do not match are left untouched.

activeVersion.description: Drop Headline label (Button only). Remove screenshot-attach nodes since new-key visibility cannot be OCR-verified in the webhook; workflow now tags new keys with screen + Button and writes a description. Route matched keys straight to tagging.
